supported_workflows: Product search relevance benchmarking (exact, substitute, complement, irrelevant)
E-commerce query-product ranking and retrieval evaluation
Semantic product search and recommendation model development
supported_questions: Which products are exact matches for the query 'iPhone 13'?
What substitute products could satisfy the same customer need?
What complementary products are commonly bought together?
How relevant is this waiting-room chair to the query 'salon chair'?

overlap_with.nature: Both involve retail operations, but this dataset covers search/relevance while supply_chain_logic_eval covers inventory optimisation

weak_content: Amazon ESCI includes Japanese and Spanish queries; useful for multilingual retail but weakly related to a single-locale deployment
WANDS is furniture/home-goods focused; generalisation to other retail verticals is limited
primary_recommendation: Primary source for retail product-search and ranking evaluation. Use Amazon ESCI for large-scale ESCI benchmarking and WANDS for annotated home-goods relevance tasks.
